ideas.title: Minnesota's $10M Business Relief Package: A Breeding Ground for Fraud?
ideas.description: Investigate Governor Tim Walz's proposed $10M business relief package and its potential for fraud.
questions: What are the oversight mechanisms in place?
How will the funds be allocated?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential vulnerabilities in the program and shed light on the need for greater oversight.

ideas.title: The Nancy Guthrie Investigation: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the investigation into Nancy Guthrie's disappearance and the potential involvement of the Pima County Sheriff's Department.
questions: What is the current status of the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover potential wrongdoing by the Pima County Sheriff's Department and shed light on the need for greater transparency in the investigation.
